title: System back button exits the app completely!
content: On Android, pressing the system back gesture while reading comments should take me back to the feed. Instead, Circle closes the app immediately! I have to re-launch every single time.

title: Notification flood with no channel grouping
content: Woke up to 34 notifications on my lockscreen. The Android notification channels are not categorized into spaces or direct messages. Either all alerts on or all off.

title: Heavy WebView wrapper lag and battery drain
content: You can tell this is an embedded WebView. Scroll performance drops to 30fps on long discussions, and the battery drain on my phone is double that of native Flutter or React Native apps.

title: Video lessons freeze after 90 seconds
content: Embedded Vimeo/Wistia videos freeze while audio continues for a few seconds before cutting off. Impossible to complete course modules on mobile.

title: Paywall error: Cannot renew membership from Android
content: Received an error message saying paywall configuration missing when trying to renew my annual cohort pass. Customer support told me to open Chrome on PC.

title: No sensory consideration: Bright jarring white UI
content: Even in dark mode the white flash between space navigation blinds me at night. Sudden loud sound effects on notifications trigger sensory overload. Please add calm themes.

title: Draft vanished after phone call interrupted typing
content: I spent 20 minutes drafting an introduction post. An incoming phone call switched apps, and when I returned the text box was completely blank. No draft autosave!

title: Tablet layout is just a stretched phone screen
content: On my 11-inch tablet the feed is stretched edge to edge with huge empty margins and awkward line lengths. Needs an adaptive two-column or navigation rail layout.

title: No offline reading cache for subways
content: As soon as the subway enters a tunnel, discussions show an error cloud and will not let me read cached reflections or lesson notes. Needs an offline-first database.

title: Lock screen media controls missing
content: Audio events and podcast recordings stop when the phone screen turns off. No media session notification in Android quick settings to play/pause.

title: Nested comments get cramped on narrow screens
content: Replies nested 3 or 4 levels deep have tiny margins and text wraps after 3 words. Very hard to follow who is replying to whom.

title: Scrolling stutters on long reflection feeds
content: Feeds with high resolution photo uploads drop frames noticeably. Scrolling is not smooth 60fps or 120fps.

title: Search is basic and slow
content: Searching for past lessons takes several seconds and frequently returns no results if you misspell a single letter.

title: Good desktop companion, average mobile experience
content: The desktop platform is world-class, but the Android port feels second-class. Font sizes cannot be scaled properly without clipping badges.

title: Admin actions require desktop browser
content: I can browse and reply to members fine, but approving new member requests or pinning guidelines still requires a laptop.

title: Lots of potential, needs quiet hours
content: I enjoy the fellowship discussions, but push notification frequency gives me anxiety. Please provide daily digest batches.

title: Decent forum, needs better attachment handling
content: PDF attachments in discussion posts take you out to an external browser rather than viewing inline.

title: Markdown editor needs shortcut toolbar
content: Writing bold, italics, or quotes requires typing raw markdown asterisks and symbols manually on virtual keyboard.

title: Wonderful community spaces for fellowship
content: Having dedicated spaces for prayer requests, scripture reflection, and weekly fellowship makes connecting so uplifting. Great alternative to noisy social media.

title: Threaded discussions keep topics organized
content: Love the structured threads and clean author chips. Much easier to follow ongoing book club questions than Slack or WhatsApp.

title: Direct messages work great
content: One-on-one chats with mentees are prompt and clean. Would give 5 stars if notifications could be batched into an evening digest.

title: Well organized spaces and clean layout
content: Our reading group moved here two months ago. Having separate channels for introductions, discussion questions, and resources is wonderful.

title: Great community directory
content: I like being able to view member profile cards, bio information, and shared interests before starting a conversation.

title: Uplifting and respectful sanctuary for our flock
content: We host our church discipleship fellowship on Circle. Threaded discussions and prayer requests bring our community together during the week.

title: Spaces structure is so much calmer than Discord
content: As someone on the autism spectrum, Discord gives me severe sensory overload with constant pings and scrolling walls of memes. Circle spaces give me time to process and reflect peacefully.

title: Best community and course hub
content: The combination of video modules and active discussion spaces creates genuine learning camaraderie. Highly recommended for cohort courses.

title: Heartfelt fellowship and shared reflections
content: Being able to share encouragement, scripture verses, and listen to community music in a quiet online space has been a true blessing.

title: Modern UI that stays out of your way
content: Clean typography, uncluttered post cards, and clear avatar badges. A polished design for serious community engagement.

title: Favorite community app on my phone
content: I check our book club space every morning with coffee. Threaded replies make catching up an unhurried, delightful routine.

title: Peaceful place for deep Christian conversation
content: No algorithmic ads or rage-bait. Just our cohort studying scripture together and lifting one another up in prayer.
